fictional_notice: MetroPulse is a fictional, synthetic city-transit system. These are lab values produced by a deterministic simulator, not a real transit agency or a real incident.
reported_symptom: The scheduler decided the first attempt had stopped and started a second one, but the first attempt kept producing rows into the same target. The target now holds rows from two attempts for two different service days.
time_pressure: The target must not be published while it mixes two attempts.
title: The scheduler starts a second attempt while the first is still producing output
